612388271.explanation: Criteria of Identification: Funnel-shaped midline opening/depression located in the anterior hard palate immediately posterior to the central maxillary incisors; transmits the nasopalatine nerve and terminal branches of the greater palatine vessels.
612388271.keyConcept: Incisive fossa: Midline anterior hard palate depression transmitting the nasopalatine nerve.

197607323.explanation: Criteria of Identification: Smaller aperture located immediately posterior to the greater palatine foramen within the pyramidal process of the palatine bone; transmits the lesser palatine nerve and vessels to the soft palate.
197607323.keyConcept: Lesser Palatine Foramen: Located posterior to greater palatine foramen; transmits lesser palatine neurovascular bundle to soft palate.

1344534701.explanation: Criteria of Identification: Large distinct foramen located at the posterolateral corner of the hard palate, medial to the third maxillary molar tooth, at the junction between the palatine process of the maxilla and horizontal plate of the palatine bone; transmits the greater palatine nerve and vessels.
1344534701.keyConcept: Greater Palatine Foramen: Located medial to the 3rd maxillary molar; transmits greater palatine nerve and vessels to hard palate.

58662587.explanation: Criteria of Identification: Structures traversing the greater palatine foramen to supply the mucosa and glands of the hard palate and adjacent gingiva anteriorly up to the incisive fossa.
58662587.keyConcept: Greater Palatine Foramen contents: Transmits the greater palatine nerve and greater palatine vessels.

2039660236.explanation: Criteria of Identification: Neurovascular bundle passing through the lesser palatine foramen to distribute sensory fibers and blood supply to the soft palate and palatine tonsil.
2039660236.keyConcept: Lesser Palatine Foramen contents: Transmits the lesser palatine nerve and vessels to supply the soft palate.

1286470351.explanation: Criteria of Identification: Traverses the incisive canal/fossa to communicate between the nasal cavity and the oral cavity, supplying the anterior portion of the hard palate (premaxilla).
1286470351.keyConcept: Incisive fossa contents: Transmits the nasopalatine nerve and terminal branches of the greater palatine vessels.

46221362.explanation: Criteria of Identification: Thin, firm fibrous sheet forming the skeletal framework of the soft palate, attached anteriorly to the posterior free border and posterior nasal spine of the horizontal plates of the palatine bones.
46221362.keyConcept: Palatine aponeurosis: Fibrous backbone of the soft palate attached to the posterior border of the hard palate.

1118908162.explanation: Criteria of Identification: Thin, concave posterior margin of the horizontal plate of the palatine bone that gives attachment to the palatine aponeurosis and marks the transition between the hard and soft palate.
1118908162.keyConcept: Posterior border of hard palate: Free posterior edge giving attachment to the palatine aponeurosis.

770499772.explanation: Criteria of Identification: Sharp median bony projection formed by the junction of the posterior borders of the horizontal plates of both palatine bones; gives origin to the musculus uvulae.
770499772.keyConcept: Posterior nasal spine: Sharp midline posterior projection giving origin to musculus uvulae.

1197499685.explanation: Criteria of Identification: Horizontal quadrilateral bony lamina that articulates anteriorly with the palatine process of the maxilla at the transverse palatine suture and meets its contralateral counterpart at the interpalatine suture to form the posterior third of the bony palate.
1197499685.keyConcept: Horizontal plate of palatine bone: Forms posterior 1/3 of the hard palate.

1575370335.explanation: Criteria of Identification: Thick horizontal medial projection of the maxilla that meets the opposite side at the median palatine suture to form the anterior two-thirds of the hard palate.
1575370335.keyConcept: Palatine process of maxilla: Forms the anterior 2/3 of the hard palate.

1107121594.explanation: Criteria of Identification: Slender vertical muscle arising from the scaphoid fossa and auditory tube whose tendon hooks around the pterygoid hamulus at a right angle to insert into the palatine aponeurosis; innervated by the mandibular nerve (CN V3).
1107121594.keyConcept: Tensor veli palatini: Tenses soft palate; tendon hooks around pterygoid hamulus; innervated by CN V3.

1630163339.explanation: Criteria of Identification: Cylindrical muscle descending obliquely downwards and medially from the petrous temporal bone and auditory tube cartilage directly into the upper surface of the soft palate without winding around any bone; innervated by the pharyngeal plexus (CN X).
1630163339.keyConcept: Levator veli palatini: Elevates soft palate; descends directly into palate; innervated by CN X via pharyngeal plexus.

2139919664.explanation: Criteria of Identification: Smallest and most inferior cartilaginous/bony element of the sternum located in the epigastric fossa in the midline at the T9/T10 vertebral level.
2139919664.keyConcept: Xiphoid process: Inferior end of sternum marking the infrasternal angle and level of T9/T10.

2127635465.explanation: Criteria of Identification: Point where the right linea semilunaris crosses the costal margin; lies at the level of the transpyloric plane (L1) and corresponds surface-anatomically to the fundus of the gallbladder.
2127635465.keyConcept: Tip of 9th costal cartilage: Intersected by transpyloric plane and right linea semilunaris; overlies gallbladder fundus.

1369925797.explanation: Criteria of Identification: Fibrous cicatrix in the anterior abdominal midline resulting from the site of attachment of the umbilical cord; typically lies in the linea alba at the level of the intervertebral disc between L3 and L4 (T10 dermatome).
1369925797.keyConcept: Umbilicus: Midline scar in linea alba; landmark for transumbilical plane and T10 dermatome.

432934851.explanation: Criteria of Identification: Lower boundary of the thoracic cage formed by the cartilages of the 7th through 10th ribs curving obliquely downwards and laterally from the xiphisternal joint.
432934851.keyConcept: Costal margin: Sloping lower border of the thoracic wall formed by the 7th–10th costal cartilages.

1672027564.explanation: Criteria of Identification: Palpable superior curved bony margin of the ala of the ilium extending between the anterior superior iliac spine (ASIS) and posterior superior iliac spine (PSIS); highest point lies at the L4 vertebral level.
1672027564.keyConcept: Iliac crest: Superior margin of ilium; highest point corresponds to the L4 supracristal plane.

488205806.explanation: Criteria of Identification: Dense band formed by the rolled-under lower free border of the external oblique aponeurosis spanning from the anterior superior iliac spine (ASIS) to the pubic tubercle.
488205806.keyConcept: Inguinal ligament: Lower rolled-in border of external oblique aponeurosis between ASIS and pubic tubercle.

133539085.explanation: Criteria of Identification: Curved shallow groove on the anterior abdominal wall marking the lateral border of the rectus abdominis muscle, extending from the tip of the 9th costal cartilage to the pubic tubercle.
133539085.keyConcept: Linea semilunaris: Curved groove along the lateral border of the rectus abdominis muscle.
